title: Identify the Real Problem
hook: Sometimes the sales problem is really an offer problem. No amount of sales training fixes that.
statement: Most failures come from solving the wrong problem.
explainer: Symptoms are loud and obvious, so they get all the attention. But fix a symptom and it comes right back. Keep asking why until you hit the real cause.
sop: Write the problem the way you see it right now.
Ask why it's happening, then ask why again, five times total.
Score Real Problem and Symptom Confusion 1 to 10.
Solve for the answer at level 4 or 5, not level 1.
If the symptom comes back in a month, you stopped digging too early.
equation_example: Real Problem clarity 3, Symptom Confusion 8. 3 ÷ 8 = 0.375, call it 0.4. Well below 1 means you're probably treating a symptom, so keep digging. Near or above 1 means you've found the root.
question: Pick one problem you're fixing right now and ask why five times, in writing.
closing_statement: Treat the symptom as a clue, not the cause.
caption:
Principle Nº 113: Identify the Real Problem

Sometimes the sales problem is really an offer problem. No amount of sales training fixes that.

Most failures come from solving the wrong problem.

Your turn: Pick one problem you're fixing right now and ask why five times, in writing.
